summary: Instant, typo-tolerant search over your own content without writing a search engine: Meilisearch on a small box behind Caddy, an idempotent indexing script, a search-only key for the browser, and a search box under 5 KB that works without JavaScript too.

stack.why: rule zero: do not write a search engine

stack.choice: A VPS with a few GB of RAM behind Caddy

prerequisites.name: Node.js 22 or newer
prerequisites.why: Everything in this build runs on it: the server, the scripts, the tests.
prerequisites.get: Download the LTS installer from nodejs.org, or install with your package manager (brew install node, or nvm install 22). Restart the terminal afterwards.

prerequisites.name: A terminal and a code editor
prerequisites.why: Every step below is a command you type or a file you edit.
prerequisites.get: VS Code (code.visualstudio.com), Cursor or Zed. Open a folder for the project and use the editor's built-in terminal.
prerequisites.verify: You can open a folder and run a command in its terminal

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.why: History for your code, and the way most hosts deploy.
prerequisites.get: Install from git-scm.com or with your package manager, then run git init in the project folder once it exists.

prerequisites.name: A VPS with 4 GB of RAM
prerequisites.why: Meilisearch holds the index in memory.

prerequisites.name: Meilisearch
prerequisites.get: curl -L https://install.meilisearch.com | sh, or the Docker image getmeili/meilisearch.

prerequisites.name: Your content as files, JSON or a database
prerequisites.get: Markdown files, a JSON export, or a database connection string.

prerequisites.name: A domain or subdomain
prerequisites.get: Register at Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun or Namecheap, or use a subdomain of one you already own. You add one DNS record in the deploy phase.
prerequisites.cost: roughly $10 a year, or free on an existing domain

prerequisites.name: Caddy on the server
prerequisites.why: Automatic HTTPS in front of the Node process. Without TLS the browser features this relies on (and your visitors' trust) do not work.
prerequisites.get: On the VPS: follow the install steps at caddyserver.com/docs/install for Ubuntu. One Caddyfile with your domain and a reverse_proxy line is the whole config.
prerequisites.verify: caddy version prints a version on the server

env.name: MEILI_MASTER_KEY
env.where: openssl rand -base64 32; admin key, server-side only.

env.name: MEILI_SEARCH_KEY
env.where: Generated in Phase 3; safe for the browser.

phases.title: Run it
phases.goal: Meilisearch bound to localhost with a master key, Caddy in front.

steps.do: Install and run with MEILI_MASTER_KEY, bound to 127.0.0.1:7700

check: The health endpoint answers over HTTPS
The master key is required for admin calls

phases.title: Index
phases.goal: Documents with id, title, url, body and tags; idempotent.

steps.do: Write index.mjs reading CONTENT_DIR into documents and setting searchable and displayed attributes
commands: mkdir search-index && cd search-index && git init && npm init -y && npm pkg set type=module && npm install meilisearch@0.4

steps.do: Make it idempotent on a content hash; delete removed documents

phases.title: Keys
phases.goal: A search-only key for the browser; the master key never leaves the server.

steps.do: Create a search-only API key scoped to the index
Put it in the page; verify it cannot write

phases.title: The box
phases.goal: Results as you type, highlighted, keyboard-driven, under 5 KB, degrades to a form.

steps.do: Vanilla-JS search box with debounce and highlighting
A server-rendered /search?q= fallback for JavaScript off

check: A typo still finds the right result

phases.title: Operate

steps.do: systemd unit, nightly snapshot, reindex step in your deploy
README: the key model in two sentences and how to reindex

check: A restore from snapshot searches correctly

phases.title: Relevance tuning
phases.goal: Synonyms, ranking rules, and a way to measure.

steps.do: Configure synonyms and ranking rules for your domain
Log queries with zero results and review them weekly

check: A synonym fixes one of them

product.outcome: Search you operate with a relevance loop, at a fraction of the hosted price, with the edge stated as the thing you gave up.

architecture.swap: Typesense with the same document shape

operations.backup: Nightly snapshots; the index is rebuildable from content.
operations.incident: A leaked master key: rotate and regenerate search keys.

notIncluded: Merchandising rules, AI ranking, the global edge: commerce money.
